name: ZN vs ES: NFP vs CPI Intraday Reaction (5-Min Bars)
description: Compares 10-Year T-Note (ZN) and S&P 500 E-Mini (ES) intraday reactions to NFP and CPI releases at 8:30 AM ET on 5-min bars. Uses LiquidityBased rollover with BackwardRatio adjustment. Detects release days via common_economic_indicators, anchors on the 8:30 ET bar, and measures forward returns at 5, 15, and 30 minutes. Per-asset: summary table (avg absolute move + event count) and grouped bar chart (NFP vs CPI by interval). Cross-sectional: scatter of avg signed 5-min returns per asset (NFP on x-axis, CPI on y-axis). Event markers for NFP and CPI with signed returns at all three horizons.
source:
# =============================================================================
# ZN vs ES INTRADAY REACTION: NFP vs CPI AT 8:30 AM ET (5-Min Bars)
# =============================================================================
# Detects NFP and CPI release days via common_economic_indicators.
# Anchors on the 8:30 AM ET bar, measures forward_returns at 5, 15, 30 min.
# Per-asset: summary table (avg |move| + count) + grouped bar chart.
# Cross-sectional: scatter of avg signed 5-min returns (NFP vs CPI per asset).
# Event markers: NFP and CPI with signed 5/15/30 min returns.
# =============================================================================

# === DATA SOURCE (5-Min bars) ===
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation( s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
close = cont.c

# === MACRO DATA: NFP & CPI RELEASE DAY DETECTION ===
nfp_data = common_economic_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.NonfarmPayrolls)()
cpi_data = common_economic_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.CPI)()

# ffill_day carries the value through the trading day, resets next day
nfp_filled = ffill_day(nfp_data.result)
cpi_filled = ffill_day(cpi_data.result)

is_nfp_day = is_valid(nfp_filled)
is_cpi_day = is_valid(cpi_filled)

# === 8:30 AM ET BAR DETECTION ===
bar_ts = index()
bar_hour = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.hour, timezone='America/New_York')(bar_ts)
bar_minute = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.minute, timezone='America/New_York')(bar_ts)
is_830 = (bar_hour == 8) and (bar_minute == 30)

# === RELEASE BAR FLAGS ===
is_nfp_release = is_nfp_day and is_830
is_cpi_release = is_cpi_day and is_830

# === FORWARD RETURNS FROM RELEASE BAR ===
fwd_5m = forward_returns(period=1)(close)    # 1 bar ahead = 5 min
fwd_15m = forward_returns(period=3)(close)   # 3 bars ahead = 15 min
fwd_30m = forward_returns(period=6)(close)   # 6 bars ahead = 30 min

# === NFP: SIGNED RETURNS (filtered to release bar + valid forward return) ===
nfp_ret_5m = where(is_nfp_release and is_valid(fwd_5m), fwd_5m)
nfp_ret_15m = where(is_nfp_release and is_valid(fwd_15m), fwd_15m)
nfp_ret_30m = where(is_nfp_release and is_valid(fwd_30m), fwd_30m)

# === CPI: SIGNED RETURNS ===
cpi_ret_5m = where(is_cpi_release and is_valid(fwd_5m), fwd_5m)
cpi_ret_15m = where(is_cpi_release and is_valid(fwd_15m), fwd_15m)
cpi_ret_30m = where(is_cpi_release and is_valid(fwd_30m), fwd_30m)

# === ABSOLUTE MOVES FOR SUMMARY TABLE & BAR CHART ===
nfp_abs_5m = where(is_nfp_release and is_valid(fwd_5m), abs(fwd_5m))
nfp_abs_15m = where(is_nfp_release and is_valid(fwd_15m), abs(fwd_15m))
nfp_abs_30m = where(is_nfp_release and is_valid(fwd_30m), abs(fwd_30m))

cpi_abs_5m = where(is_cpi_release and is_valid(fwd_5m), abs(fwd_5m))
cpi_abs_15m = where(is_cpi_release and is_valid(fwd_15m), abs(fwd_15m))
cpi_abs_30m = where(is_cpi_release and is_valid(fwd_30m), abs(fwd_30m))

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# --- 1. Summary Table: Avg |Move| + Count by Release Type (per asset) ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Avg Absolute Move After NFP vs CPI (5-Min Bars, 8:30 ET)',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['NFP', 'CPI'],
        col_headers=['Avg |Move| 5min', 'Avg |Move| 15min', 'Avg |Move| 30min', 'Count'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Release Magnitude',
    order=0
)(nfp_abs_5m, nfp_abs_15m, nfp_abs_30m, nfp_abs_5m, cpi_abs_5m, cpi_abs_15m, cpi_abs_30m, cpi_abs_5m)

# --- 2. Grouped Bar Chart: NFP vs CPI by Interval (per asset) ---
# Stack groups = x-axis categories (5-Min, 15-Min, 30-Min)
# Series names = legend entries (NFP, CPI), reused across stacks
xy_bars(
    title='Avg Absolute Move by Interval: NFP vs CPI',
    category='1. Release Magnitude',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    y_axis_label='Avg |Move|',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='NFP', color=Color.Blue, stack='5-Min'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='CPI', color=Color.Indigo, stack='5-Min'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='NFP', color=Color.Blue, stack='15-Min'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='CPI', color=Color.Indigo, stack='15-Min'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='NFP', color=Color.Blue, stack='30-Min'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='CPI', color=Color.Indigo, stack='30-Min')
    ]),
    order=1
)(nfp_abs_5m, cpi_abs_5m, nfp_abs_15m, cpi_abs_15m, nfp_abs_30m, cpi_abs_30m)

# --- 3. Cross-Sectional Scatter: Per-Asset Avg Signed 5-Min Return ---
# XY mode: each asset (ZN, ES) becomes one point at (mean NFP return, mean CPI return)
# Shows whether ZN and ES react in opposite directions to the same releases
cs_scatter(
    title='ZN vs ES: Avg Signed 5-Min Return at 8:30 ET',
    category='2. ZN vs ES Direction',
    x_axis_label='Avg NFP 5-Min Signed Return',
    y_axis_label='Avg CPI 5-Min Signed Return',
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=3,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=2
)(nfp_ret_5m, cpi_ret_5m)

# --- Event Markers: NFP Releases ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='NFP Release',
        icon=Icon.BellRingIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='5-Min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='15-Min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='30-Min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    )
)(is_nfp_release and is_valid(fwd_5m), nfp_ret_5m, nfp_ret_15m, nfp_ret_30m)

# --- Event Markers: CPI Releases ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='CPI Release',
        icon=Icon.ActivityIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='5-Min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='15-Min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='30-Min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    )
)(is_cpi_release and is_valid(fwd_5m), cpi_ret_5m, cpi_ret_15m, cpi_ret_30m)
